references.text: The midwives Shiphrah and Puah feared God and did not obey Pharaoh's command, and God blessed them for their faith
A midwife assists Rachel during her difficult birth, illustrating the role of midwives in Israel's history
A midwife is present at Tamar's birth of twins, another reference to the service of midwives among the Hebrews
The background to Pharaoh's command to the midwives: a new king over Egypt who did not know Joseph and feared the growth of the Israelites
Hebrews mentions the faith of Moses' parents who hid him, in connection with the midwives' resistance against Pharaoh
Stephen speaks about how Pharaoh acted wickedly toward the Israelites and forced them to expose their infants
